messages:
deploybot: tag v1.12.0-rc3 published for release.
Commit: 3a9f2b7 (build/infra: kernel opt + batching).
Changelog (high level): fixed kv-cache mem leak; added dynamic batching tunables; safer model-fallback path; docs + metrics.
Envs: canary -> us-west-2 (5% traffic), staging -> staging (tagged), prod -> scheduled 2026-03-22 01:00 UTC.
Risk: medium (runtime kernel selection change). CI: green.
Rollout: canary 2h, auto-promote if error rate <1% and p99 latency delta <10ms. On error or >5% user error rate in 15m -> immediate rollback to v1.11.8.
Please ops/oncall pin the prod image after canary looks OK. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/1.12.0-rc3 (short).

celeste: thanks — I'll monitor canary and smoke tests. Any manual migrations or config flips?
matt: no DB migrations. batching flag is off by default; will flip only after prod promote. KV cache mem fix is a runtime patch, no data migrations.
sre-lee: oncall here. I'll pin and run smoke once canary stable. If I see error spikes I'll call rollback and post commands. Ping me @sre-lee.
ops-oncall: pinned staging and started canary allocation. Running health checks now.

deploybot: canary rollout started at 1967532130 to us-west-2 (5%).

ops-oncall: smoke checks after 10m: all green. 200/200 requests OK, latency +2ms median. Leaving canary to run full 2h. :thumbsup:

celeste: noted. If anything crosses thresholds, rollback plan is validated — run this to rollback quickly:
```
# rollback to previous stable
git fetch origin && git checkout tags/v1.11.8
./infra/deploy --env=prod --tag=v1.11.8 --force
```

sre-lee: acked. I'll watch SLO dashboards; will escalate if errors >5% sustained 10m.

deploybot: canary completed at 1967532160 — no anomalies detected. Prod push remains scheduled at 2026-03-22 01:00 UTC.

ops-oncall: will prep prod pin 30m before window and run final smoke. Will post confirmation when pinned.

celeste: thanks team. tagging this thread for post-release notes and followup perf checks. :white_check_mark:
